channel.title: Homer Development Kit tutorials
channel.description: Short spoken walkthroughs of building accessible Windows programs with the Homer Development Kit. Each episode is one task, with the narration in one voice and the screen reader in another.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: The Homer Development Kit, and two fruit baskets
item.description: You need Windows 10 or later, 64-bit, and a screen reader running. Everything else the kit fetches for itself. Nothing in this tutorial costs anything. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-the-homer-development-kit-and-two-fruit-baskets
